items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: There was Tyree, Benny Morton and Dickie.

ctx.x: Well we don't have to go into

that /but this was interesting to me you know, because they'd all four come out of that same period. There was Tyree, Benny Morton and Dickie. So you know, they were saying well, they've been playing with that old style for vibrato . You can't do that any more. Which I thought was rather funny.
